text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: pd-triggered | service=inference-gateway | env=prod-eu-west1 | alert=5xx-rate > 8% over 2m · count=1.2k · current=14% · pagerid=PDT12345

maria (oncall): acked. I'm on it. any obvious customer impact?

sam (eng-sre): seeing spike correlated with a canary rollout to eu-west1 around 09:42UTC. 95th latency ok but 5xxs cluster-wide on gateway fronting model variants.

daniel (infra): infra graphs: host-level looks normal, connections fine. kvcache eviction spike at 09:40. suspect upstream model container OOM/restarts.
eva (prod-eng): customers: no major 500-only errors in top customer logs yet, but a couple of requests retried by clients. ramping rate on smaller models.
maria (oncall): plan: 1) enable linear backoff pager damping to avoid duplicate pages while we triage 2) divert 20% traffic to dedicated pool in eu-central region as warm fallback 3) roll back canary if we confirm causality.
sam (eng-sre): +1. can you flip the pd-suppression policy? command: `infractl pagerduty suppression set --policy linear-backoff --window 120s --factor 2`
daniel (infra): running that now...
```bash
$ infractl pagerduty suppression set --policy linear-backoff --window 120s --factor 2
Applying suppression policy to inference-gateway... done (rule-id=sb-84bc)
```
eva (prod-eng): I’ll start diverting 20% to dedicated eu-central pool and warm a couple of small-quant models. `redwoodctl traffic-route set --service inference-gateway --region eu-central --weight 0.2`
sam (eng-sre): rolling back canary to stable variant (canary-id=cny-907)
```bash
$ redwoodctl rollout rollback --canary cny-907 --reason "5xx spike"
Initiated rollback...
```

maria (oncall): status check in 3m. metrics: 5xx from 14% -> 6% after suppression + diversion (first 90s). visible customer error reports: 2 users reporting degraded throughput, CS notified.
sam (eng-sre): logs show model container restart spike at 09:41:12. increasing container memory for that variant as emergency patch: `k apply -f model-variant-memory-patch.yaml`
daniel (infra): scaled dedicated pool by +2 G5 nodes and bumped autoscaler min to avoid thrash.
eva (prod-eng): warming kv-cache via synthetic prefix requests to reduce cold miss rate.
maria (oncall): PD suppression and traffic diversion holding. 5xx now steady at ~3.5%. I'll stay on until stable <1% for 10m. filing follow-up incident report. :thumbsup:

sam (eng-sre): thanks all. when we close I'll post small blameless note: cause = canary model variant memory regression + kvcache pressure; mitigations = rollback, scale, suppression, kvcache warm, memory bump.
maria (oncall): closing checks at 10:12UTC. leaving suppression rule in place for next hour. pausing alerts for noisy signal. will update incident doc shortly.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page resolved · pagerid=PDT12345 · acknowledged by maria (oncall)

eva (prod-eng): follow-up tasks: create a postmortem eval harness for that variant + add a preflight memory regression test.
maria (oncall): noted. thanks everyone. out for now. :wave:
